latest_release.name: v0.15.0
latest_release.body:
Router purchases recover after an interruption without a second charge, swarm dissolution refuses while a worker is active or unresolved, and `vapi login` works on more Linux keyrings.

### Added

- CLI `vapi router clear-pending --confirm-settled` saves any missing succeeded receipt, prints payment evidence and support guidance, then retires a settled journal under the purchase lock. JSON adds `receipt`, `receiptAppended` and `notice`; prepared, signed and unknown entries are refused. The flag is exclusive with `--confirm-unpaid` and has no MCP equivalent.
- CLI purchase/refill JSON and MCP purchase/refill output add optional `receipt.settlement` (`succeeded`, `rejected` or `unknown`). MCP output schemas accept `settlement_unconfirmed`, `credit_pending` and `pending_purchase_unlinked` warnings.
- The Router subentry exports `ensureRouterPurchaseReceipt` to record settled purchase evidence; a separate strict sync gates retirement. Pending purchase journals optionally record `baselinePurchasedUsd`; older entries remain recoverable through a successful balance-key chat.
- Payment warnings add `settlement_unconfirmed`, `credit_pending` and `pending_purchase_unlinked` to distinguish unconfirmed authorizations, credit awaiting confirmation, and settled purchases whose link changed.
- `vapi router clear-pending [--confirm-unpaid]` prints public payment evidence and explorer instructions. Before clearing, the CLI uses the same receipt/authorization-state resolution as automatic recovery: paid attempts and live authorizations are refused, and unused expired authorizations can clear. Only when chain evidence is unavailable may explicit human confirmation override the guard; output identifies that confirmation as lacking chain evidence. There is no MCP equivalent.
- CLI `vapi swarm forget-run <swarm> <runId> --confirm-destroyed` lets an owner confirm a verified unknown/orphaned sandbox is destroyed. It prints the original recorded scope and check command, retains a timestamped `forgotten` run record and retires the matching sidecar. Missing scope is reported rather than guessed.
- MCP adds `swarm.stop` with `name` and exactly one of `runId` or `all: true`. `VapiServerOptions.runtimeForStop` optionally resolves stop-only adapters by runtime kind. The CLI-hosted server supplies local/Railway stop adapters without enabling remote startup or stale-start confirmation over MCP.
- `PayRequestArgs` adds optional `beforeSign` (also on x402 payment builders) for durable public authorization journaling before signing, and optional `receiptId` to correlate a durable purchase reservation with its receipt ledger entry. The Router subentry exports `routerPurchaseView`, the shared public receipt/warning projection.
- Core exports the `PaymentWarning` type. The Router subentry exports `RouterPurchaseResult`, `RouterPurchaseWarning` and `routerPurchaseSummary`.
- Core exports `PAYMENT_WARNING_CODES`, the list every payment warning schema is derived from, and `swarmRunRefillSchema`. Swarm member results, delegation records and the MCP Router tools accept the same warning codes and the receipt's `settlement` outcome, so a refill with an unconfirmed settlement or pending credit no longer fails output validation in a swarm run.
- Core exports `RouterPendingPurchase`. Wallet entries expose its public recovery metadata in memory, while `WalletStore.setRouterPendingPurchase` atomically reserves, updates or clears the matching record in `router-pending/<wallet>.json`, separate from the v1 wallet registry. Older registry writers cannot erase it. Existing registry records migrate on read; legacy `prepared` records remain `unknown` because older clients did not journal signing. Empty tombstones prevent stale registry snapshots from resurrecting cleared purchases.

### Breaking

- MCP runtime `RuntimeError.code` adds `swarm_unavailable` and `launch_ambiguous`. `startDetachedRun` reserves swarm members under the swarm lock before taking their member lock, revalidates

detail.readme:
# vAPI Network

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/vapi-network?label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/vapi-network)
[![CI](https://github.com/vAPI-Network/vapi-network/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/vAPI-Network/vapi-network/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: Apache-2.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-blue)](./LICENSE)
[![Node.js 22 or newer](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org)

**One wallet, every x402 API.** `vapi-network` is the open-source, non-custodial
TypeScript client for discovering and paying x402 services in USDC, from a terminal,
an MCP client or your own code. It pays on Base by default and on Arc when you enable
it; [Networks](#networks) lists what works where.

The client gives one local wallet to you and to your agents. You search every x402
catalogue at once, pay an API per call under spend caps you set, and keep a receipt
for each payment. The same wallet gives each agent its own capped account, buys model
access on vAPI Router and moves USDC between your accounts.

vAPI Network builds payment and trust infrastructure for AI agents. Call,
Router, Stake and Agents are live on production. Tasks is coming soon. See
[vapinetwork.ai](https://vapinetwork.ai) and the
[documentation](https://docs.vapinetwork.ai).

vAPI Network is not related to Vapi.ai, the voice AI company.

## Quickstart

This README describes client 0.15.0. `npm view vapi-network version` shows the latest published release.
The client needs Node.js 22 or newer.

```bash
npm i -g vapi-network
vapi setup [--no-cloud-backup]   # creates or restores the vault, derives main, links it to your owner wallet; safe to rerun
vapi fund                        # opens the hosted funding page for your address
vapi search "weather"            # every catalogue, merged, with provenance
vapi pay <listing-ref> --max 0.02
vapi receipts                    # one line per paid call: quote, settlement, latency
```

No install? Prefix any command with `npx vapi-network`, for example
`npx vapi-network setup`. (`npx vapi` cannot work: the bare `vapi` name on npm
belongs to an unrelated package.)

Back up the recovery phrase only in a terminal; vAPI cannot recover it.
Turn on encrypted cloud backup with `vapi backup --cloud`; only the owner can approve a restore.
On a server, a container or GitHub Codespaces, read
[Linux without a keyring](./docs/wallets.md#linux-without-a-keyring) before `vapi setup`.

An agent can set itself up from the agent skill. Tell it: "Read
https://vapinetwork.ai/SKILL.md and follow it to set up vAPI." The same file
ships in this package as [SKILL.md](./packages/vapi-network/SKILL.md), with the
CLI version it describes in its frontmatter.

Interactive CLI runs check for a newer release at most once a day and cache the result in
`~/.vapi/update-check.json`. JSON, MCP server, CI and non-TTY runs skip the check. Set
`VAPI_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1` to disable it.

## How a payment works

The device vault encrypts your keys on this machine, using an OS-stored device key
with optional password protection. vAPI applies your spend caps before signing,
sends the payment straight to the service, and writes a local receipt. There is no
payment proxy and no server-side signer. vAPI Call takes no fee; providers are paid
directly.

Local runs keep keys on this machine; experimental Railway runs require explicit
member-key export. Call and discovery metrics are measured locally and nothing is
uploaded unless you send a report yourself. Every payment identifies this client as
`vapi` through x402 `builder-code`; when an API advertises `payment-identifier`, the
generated id is kept on that receipt.

## What is in this repository

Everything that runs on your machine is in this repository under the Apache-2.0
license. That covers the wallet and its spend caps, x402 signing, the receipt ledger,
catalogue search, the CLI, the MCP server, the SDK and the desktop app. You can read
how a payment is built and signed before you make one.

The client also talks to hosted vAPI services. Their source is not in this repository.

| Hosted service | The client uses it to                                                                    |
| -------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| vAPI Call      | search the vAPI registry, and publish or claim a listing                                 |
| Owner link     | connect this device's accounts to your owner wallet during `vapi setup` and `vapi login` |
| vAPI Router    | buy and use model access, and read your balance and stake status                         |
| Transfer relay | submit a transfer you signed between your own accounts, and pay its gas                  |
| Cloud backup   | keep an encrypted vault copy that only the owner can restore                             |
| Funding page   | take a card, wallet or bridge deposit and deliver USDC on Base                           |
| Tasks          | preview task posting and escrow; coming soon on production                               |

A payment to an x402 API does not pass through these services. The client signs it
and sends it to the API's own endpoint. Search also reads Coinbase Bazaar, x402scan
and a local file, and `VAPI_REGISTRY_URL` points the client at another registry.

## Networks

Payments are in USDC. Base is on by default; you enable the other networks per machine.

| Network                             | Pay x402 APIs   | Send between accounts | Sweep                | How to enable                                                     |
| ----------------------------------- | --------------- | --------------------- | -------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Base mainnet                        | yes             | yes                   | USDC and ETH         | on by default                                                     |
| Arc mainnet                         | yes             | yes                   | USDC                 | `vapi init --networks base,arc` or `vapi accounts --enable arc`   |
| Arc testnet                         | yes             | no                    | USDC                 | set `ARC_TESTNET_RPC_URL`                                         |
| Base Sepolia and other EVM networks | when configured | no                    | USDC when configured | add the RPC URL and USDC address to `config.json`                 |
| Solana mainnet                      | not yet         | no                    | no                   | listings are searchable; paying one returns `unsupported_network` |

The hosted funding page delivers USDC on Base. On Arc, USDC is also the gas token.
Identifiers, token addresses and RPC defaults are in
[docs/configuration.md](./docs/configuration.md#networks-and-accounts).

## Three ways to use it

The CLI, the MCP server and the SDK share one vault, one set of spend caps and one
receipt ledger under `~/.vapi/`.

Register the MCP server with your agent client, then ask it to "Search vAPI for a
weather API":

```bash
vapi mcp install <claude-code|claude-desktop|cursor|codex>
```

Call the same client from TypeScript:

```ts
import { createVapiClient } from "vapi-network";

const vapi = await createVapiClient({ account: "researcher" });
const listings = await vapi.call.search("Base DEX volume");
const result = await vapi.call.pay({ id: "base-dex-volume", maxPriceUsd: 0.05 });
console.log(result.body);
```

The MCP server has no tool that reveals a recovery phrase or a private key, and no
tool that creates or retires a listing. The tool list is in [docs/mcp.md](./docs/mcp.md#tools).

## What you can do

| Surface      | What it does                                                                             | Guide                                                        |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Call         | Discover, check, publish and pay for x402 APIs.                                          | [docs/call.md](./docs/call.md)                               |
| Router       | Use vAPI Router for model access and balance.                                            | [docs/router.md](./docs/router.md)                           |
| Coding tools | Run Claude Code and Codex on your daily Compute allowance.                               | [docs/code.md](./docs/code.md)                               |
| Tasks        | Preview task posting, USDC escrow and delivery; coming soon on production.               | [docs/tasks.md](./docs/tasks.md)                             |
| Agents       | Run capped local agents with dedicated wallets and profiles.                             | [docs/agents.md](./docs/agents.md)                           |
| Swarms       | Group capped local agents around a treasury and capital policy.                          | [docs/swarms.md](./docs/swarms.md)                           |
| MCP          | Use namespaced payment tools from an MCP client.                                         | [docs/mcp.md](./docs/mcp.md)                                 |
| SDK          | Use Call, vAPI Router and local agents behind one wallet-bound API.                      | [docs/sdk.md](./docs/sdk.md)                                 |
| Vault        | Manage the owner wallet, device vault, accounts and spend caps.                          | [docs/wallets.md](./docs/wallets.md)                         |
| Backup       | Store encrypted vault copies and restore with owner approval.                            | [docs/backup-and-recovery.md](./docs/backup-and-recovery.md) |
| Sending      | Move USDC between your accounts or to your owner wallet; vAPI pays the gas.              | [docs/sending.md](./docs/sending.md)                         |
| CI check     | Check an x402 API for a conformant 402 in GitHub Actions, with no wallet and no payment. | [docs/call.md](./docs/call.md#check-your-api)                |

Every command, option and exit code is in the [CLI reference](./docs/cli.md).
Configuration, funding, networks and bug reports are in
[docs/configuration.md](./docs/configuration.md). Two runnable SDK examples are in [examples/](./examples).
When something fails, start with [docs/troubleshooting.md](./docs/troubleshooting.md).
The full list of guides is in [docs/README.md](./docs/README.md).

## Packages

| Package                 | Purpose                                                                 |
| ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `vapi-network`          | zero-dependency distribution with the `vapi` binary and defaults        |
| `@vapi-network/core`    | x402 protocol, wallet store, spend policy, discovery merge and receipts |
| `@vapi-network/sources` | vAPI Registry, Coinbase Bazaar, local-file and x402scan source adapters |
| `@vapi-network/mcp`     | stdio MCP server with namespaced payment tools                          |
| `@vapi-network/cli`     | command parsing and the command implementations behind `vapi`           |

Every npm tarball is bundled and has zero runtime dependencies. The scoped
packages are useful for embedding; most users should start with `vapi-network`.
All five packages share one version and are released together; each release is
described in [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md).

## vAPI Desktop

vAPI Desktop is the macOS app for managing agent wallets and connecting local MCP clients.
The signer process keeps keys on your computer.
Version 0.1.0 is not released yet; signing and notarization are pending. The source is in `apps/desktop`.
See [the desktop release guide](apps/desktop/RELEASE.md) for building and signing the app.

## Support and community

| You have                             | Go to                                                                             |
| ------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| A bug in the CLI, MCP server or SDK  | [Open an issue](https://github.com/vAPI-Network/vapi-network/issues/new/choose)   |
| A question or an idea                | [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/vAPI-Network/vapi-network/discussions)    |
| An account, points or quest question | [Discord](https://discord.gg/vapinetwork) or [Telegram](https://t.me/vapinetwork) |
| An API you want listed on vAPI Call  | `vapi publish`, described in [docs/call.md](./docs/call.md#publish-an-api)        |
| A vulnerability                      | security@vapinetwork.ai, described in [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md)                |

[SUPPORT.md](./SUPPORT.md) says what to include so a report can be answered in one round.

## Contributing

Bug fixes, tests, documentation and discovery sources are welcome. Read
[CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md) for the setup, the checks and the sign-off each
commit needs, and [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md) for the layout and the invariants a change
must keep. Participation is governed by the [Code of Conduct](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm check
pnpm build
pnpm pack:check
```
